title: Solid-OIDC Client Identifier Document
description: Structural validation for a Solid-OIDC Client ID Document. No official schema is published for this format, so this one is hand-authored from the normative text of the Solid-OIDC spec (https://solidproject.org/TR/oidc#clientids) and the OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration metadata fields it reuses (RFC 7591 section 2, https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7591#section-2). It only covers what a JSON Schema can express structurally — see scripts/validate_client_id_documents.py for the one spec requirement that can't be (the `client_id` field must equal the document's own published URL), and treat 'valid against this schema' as necessary but not sufficient for spec conformance.

@context.description: Solid-OIDC 5.1 MUSTs this exact context IRI.

client_id.description: Checked against this document's own published URL in scripts/validate_client_id_documents.py, not here.

redirect_uris.description: RFC 7591 2.: array of redirection URIs the client can use.

scope.description: RFC 7591 2. defines this as a space-separated string, not an array. Solid-OIDC 7 requires the `webid` scope value; plain OIDC requires `openid`.
